_instructions: Fill in one of these per physical food item BEFORE photographing it. One item_id may have multiple sessions (e.g. re-photographed the next day as spoilage progresses) — give each sitting its own session_id. See docs/datasets/CAPTURE_METADATA_TEMPLATE.md for field definitions and docs/datasets/PILOT_CHECKLIST.md for the first 10-20 images.
item_id: <item_NNNNN, sequential, assigned once per physical food item>
session_id: <session_a / session_b / ... unique within this item_id only>
food_description: <free text, e.g. 'sliced white bread, half loaf'>
expected_label_hint: <annotator's first impression before formal labeling: normal | spoilage_indicator | mold_like_growth | uncertain -- this is NOT the final label, just a capture-time note>
photographer_id: <annotator_id of the person who took the photos>

consent.consent_form_reference: <filed location OUTSIDE Git, e.g. consent-records/2026-09-27_ann001.pdf -- never store the form itself in this repo>
